summary: Pony AI Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a monthly return submitted to HKEX for April 2026. The return reports an increase in authorized share capital of 20,000,000 Class A Ordinary Shares (par value USD 0.0005, added USD 10,000 to authorized capital) via re-designation of undesignated shares, approved at an EGM on April 2, 2026. No shares were issued during the month; total issued shares remained 352,452,783. The filing includes a public float sufficiency confirmation. This is a routine capital maintenance disclosure, not a special situation.
